title: Hruday sign-certified enclosure of the Wilson mean at the AW1-frozen coupling
selection_reason: AW1 supplies the exact first-order coefficient tau/144, the flip antisymmetry and an itemized second-order constant K_2^+; the frozen decade-grid rule fixes tau_AW2 before this loop. A single producer instantiates the enclosure; the skeptic replays it from the contract alone.
model: Same zero-selected patterned AQ subfamily; tau_AW2 from the AW1 rule at both signs; the AV1/AW1 admitted constants; fixed positive physical scales.

parameters.tau_AW2: 1/100000000 (from the AW1 rule: largest decade-grid coupling with K_2^+ tau <= 1/288, evaluated inside check.py from the AW1 gate snapshot)
parameters.first_order: tau/144 (alpha units, I1.5 convention: phi_b=-(tau/3) sum W_f, V_b=phi_b/8)
parameters.target: exclusion margin m = (|tau|/144 - K_2^+ tau^2)/(K_2^+ tau^2) >= 2 (equivalently 1/(144 K_2^+ |tau|) >= 3); report also the contract-defined sign margin 1/(144 K_2^+ |tau|) (about 207)

required: 1. Evaluate tau_AW2 inside check.py by the AW1 rule from the K_2^+ value read from the AW1 gate snapshot (hash-verified); reject any other coupling; record the rule arithmetic as exact rationals.

2. Enclose omega_tau(W) in [tau/144 - K_2^+ tau^2, tau/144 + K_2^+ tau^2] at tau=+10^-8 and -10^-8 (the mirrored enclosure follows from the AW1 flip lemma at the zero triple and is a replay, not a second confirmation); prove strict exclusion of 0 with the exclusion margin >= 2 and report the sign margin about 207; every endpoint an exact rational.

3. State the result as a static equal-time effect in the whole set of AQ1 subsequential limits at the zero selected triple (uniform in the box, passed by local trace-norm convergence); sub-label static_not_dynamic; if tau_AW2 were below the cap the sub-label sign_certified_below_cap would apply (it does not here); no dynamical correction, mass shift or susceptibility is claimed; the centered correlation shift remains unresolved (AV2 reference_unresolved).

4. Controls as damaging mutations: sign flip (tau->-tau flips the enclosure), wrong face (an omitted face other than W contributes zero at first order), centering artifact (no m_hat enters the omega(W) path; the vector/scalar centering identities are re-exhibited as fixtures), sign convention (the I1.5 string is frozen; a flipped phi_b sign mutation is rejected; the one-plaquette finite fixture under I1.5 shows sign(<W>)=sign(tau)), boundary/state (the constant is volume-uniform: the same formula at two box sizes), arithmetic (Fraction admission; scaling exponents 1 and 2 of the two terms; Arb/mpmath preview labelled), tier mixing (crude K_2 fails and is retained as a limited-tier control), coherent tampering (removing a snapshot with rebound hashes still rejected by the validator), reverse premise isolation is not applicable (single producer) and is stated as such.

5. A reusable exact calculator restricted to the proved domain (zero selected triple, |tau|<=10^-8, K_2^+ from the AW1 gate only; floats rejected); byte-identical normal and -O replays; freeze with the tools; claim flags continuum_claim:false, uniform_wilson_claim:false, resolved_interaction_shift:true only if the exclusion holds at the cap (with sub-label static_not_dynamic), scientific_priority_verified:false, dynamical_correction_claim:false, sign_certified_below_cap:<bool>.
6. The skeptic's independent pre-comparison replay from the contract alone is required for admission (single_direction_independent_replay).
